subject: Marketplace Procurement: onboarding checklist & PO mapping for Skylark Platforms
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@skylark.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@skylark.io>, procureops@skylark.io
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial procurement questions for Redwood marketplace onboarding

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for walking us through the Marketplace partner packet last week. We started collecting internal info for the vendor onboarding but had a few procurement-specific questions before we fill in Redwood's onboarding form:

- For PO routing, do you require a specific Redwood billing entity / remit-to address per region (US vs EU)?
- Is there a minimum invoice frequency you prefer (monthly vs net30 on a monthly statement)?
- Are tax IDs or W-9/W-8 forms required prior to listing?

Attached is a short procurement matrix from our side — we want to match the PO exactly to your finance expectations to avoid delays when the marketplace listing goes live.

Can we get the onboarding form you referenced yesterday and the contact for the finance onboarding team? We'll loop in our procurement folks.

Best,
Marco Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
Skylark Platforms

Attachments: skylark_procurement_matrix.pdf (PDF)

From: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@skylark.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial procurement questions for Redwood marketplace onboarding

Marco — thanks for the clear matrix. Short answers up front to help you fill things out:

- Remit / billing entity: Use Redwood Inc., EIN 12-3456789, remit to our US billing address for now. For EU customers we can accept the same billing entity; we’ll surface VAT handling in the listing metadata. If you need a localized EU contract, flag that separately.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoicing (net30) is our standard for marketplace partners. We can do quarterly for larger commitments but that's a contract exception.
- Tax paperwork: W-9 required for US entities; W-8BEN for non-US. We do need tax docs before the first payout.

I attached the Redwood Onboarding Form (redwood_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) — please complete sections A (company info), B (billing & tax), and D (marketplace metadata).

I'll put Vanessa (finance ops) and Karthik (marketplace enablement) on cc to pick up routing and listing requirements. Vanessa — can you confirm the exact remit-to line we want on Skylark's PO and whether we need their vendor code set up in our AP system before listing?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (PDF)

From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@skylark.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: procureops@skylark.io, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial procurement questions for Redwood marketplace onboarding

Hi Jonas / Vanessa,

Thanks — attached is our completed copy of sections A/B/D and a draft PO (skylark_draft_po_20261207.pdf). A couple of notes from our procurement team:

- The draft PO uses Skylark's remit info and references Redwood's quote #RWF-2247. Are you able to accept the PO referencing that quote?
- We need validation that Redwood's vendor onboarding is complete before we issue the actual PO to our AP system. Can someone confirm the vendor code and expected turnaround for vendor approvals?
- Regarding tax docs, we will attach our W-9 when we submit the final PO.

Ben — tagging you to confirm billing contact and to capture any required fields for AWS/GCP marketplace scheduling that may need separate tracking.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Priya Nair
Head of Finance Ops
Skylark Platforms

Attachments: skylark_completed_onboarding_sections_ABD.pdf (PDF); skylark_draft_po_20261207.pdf (PDF)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@skylark.io>, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial procurement questions for Redwood marketplace onboarding

Hi Priya — thanks for sending the completed sections and the PO draft. Quick confirmations:

- Vendor code: I've created a draft vendor record (VND-9876) in AP. I'll submit for approval once we receive Skylark's signed W-9 and final PO. That will generate the official vendor code for payments.
- Remit-to line: Please use "Redwood Inc., Accounts Receivable, 1100 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103" on the PO header.
- Quote reference: Acceptable to reference quote RWF-2247. We'll reconcile against that during invoicing.
- Turnaround: Once the signed PO + W-9 arrive, typical vendor activation is 3-5 business days. If you need accelerated processing for the first payout, let me know and I'll request expedited review (requires finance manager approval).

Karthik — per Skylark's note, do we need additional fields for AWS/GCP listing scheduling (e.g., product SKU, subscription term, listing price band)? I've attached the marketplace requirements spreadsheet for Skylark to fill in.

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com

Attachments: aws_marketplace_listing_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@skylark.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial procurement questions for Redwood marketplace onboarding

Thanks all — quick operational plan to keep momentum:

1) Priya/Marco: send final signed PO + W-9 to vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com and cc procureops@skylark.io. That will trigger vendor activation in our AP system.
2) Vanessa: once VND-9876 is official, please confirm here and we will queue Skylark for marketplace scheduling.
3) Ben: please prepare the listing intake (SKU mapping, pricing bands) using the attached sheet; we'll use that to submit to AWS Marketplace and GCP partner console.
4) Jonas: coordinate go-live window with Skylark and confirm any promo/commit terms for the launch.

If Skylark wants to expedite vendor activation for the first payout, Priya please indicate the requested payout date and we'll route an expedited approval. Otherwise, expect the standard 3–5 business day window after we receive the signed docs.

Onward — excited to get Skylark live.

Karthik Iyer
Marketplace Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
